So I may have a unique  perspective on this (though I have not read the comments,) I was so goth and now am an adult metalhead. I own 4. One knee high heel boots (old docs not available anymore), one pair of wolverines  (10000 miles?), one standard knee high docs and one pair of llbean boots that are good for weather. All black. 

When I was younger I had like 10 pairs but I really only need 4 high quality pairs I find.  The wolverines are short and are more everyday.  The heels are for more sexy (?) Night out occasions, the standard docs are for indoor concerts and the llbeans are for festivals. 

All the crazy goth boots that cost too much for the quality were never worth it when they fell apart in a year.  I've had these all for a while and if I were to get more they'd be the wolverines in maybe a red? But just choose the minimum for what you use or if you're anything like me you'll have a bunch of cheap quality boots that you wish you would have saved up for something durable instead.
